name: systematic-debugging
when_to_use: When an error, test failure, or unexpected behavior occurs. Governs a strict 4-phase discipline: Understand -> Reproduce -> Diagnose -> Fix.
steps: Phase 1 — Understand: Inspect the exact error output, stack trace, and failing conditions.
Phase 2 — Reproduce: Replicate the failure consistently via minimal test or command invocation.
Phase 3 — Diagnose: Trace the underlying root cause rather than treating superficial symptoms.
Phase 4 — Fix: Implement the minimal surgical fix, then verify that all test suites pass without regression.
Never propose speculative fixes without completing all four diagnostic phases.
verification: uv run pytest passes after applying the fix
